text:
anna_docs: Heads-up — opened a small PR to clarify Optimize toolkit migration behavior and add two SDK snippets (low-latency and cost-optimized). Also cleaned up quant profile mapping and fixed one example that broke on short sequences. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 and staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optkit/migration

devbot: PR #3421 opened by anna_docs · labels: docs, optkit, needs-review

mike_eng: I'll take a look tonight. quick q: are we preserving old quant profile names for compatibility (e.g., q8_0)?

anna_docs: yes — added a compatibility table and an optional sed snippet to bulk-update old configs. example: `sed -i 's/quant_profile: q8_0/quant_profile: q8_0_legacy/g' deployment.yaml`

sanjay_opt: The new SDK snippet uses `OptimizeClient.configure(batch_size=8, prefetch_kv=True)`. For latency-sensitive apps should we show a variant with `batch_size=1` and `prefetch_kv=False`? short sequences suffer from prefetch overhead.

anna_docs: Good call — added two labeled variants in the snippet section: `low-latency` and `cost-optimized`. Low-latency example:```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
client.configure(profile='low-latency', batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False, quant_profile='q8_0_legacy')
resp = client.generate("Summarize: ...")
```Cost-optimized example keeps batching/prefetch on.

lisa_pm: small product request: update the Console link in step 3 to point at the new telemetry page (I left an inline comment). also please mention that rollouts will respect the new profile mapping.

mike_eng: nit: snippet missing `from redwood import OptimizeClient` import — left inline. Also, add a short note about streaming + prefetch interaction (prefetch can increase cold-start latency for streams).

anna_docs: fixed import and added a one-paragraph note under "When to enable KV prefetch" referencing microbenchmarks. pasted smoke test log here for quick eyeball:
```
[smoke-test] profile=low-latency seq=16 tokens/sec=140 latency_p50=28ms
[smoke-test] profile=cost-optimized seq=256 tokens/sec=480 latency_p50=120ms
```

devbot: deploy-bot: staging site rebuilt — /optkit/migration updated · preview available

sanjay_opt: ran quick local check on GPU infra: KV prefetch improved throughput for long sequences but decreased tokens/sec for seq < 32. I'll add a single-line recommendation under the heuristics: "disable kv prefetch for typical short-turn dialog to keep p50 low".

anna_docs: :+1: adding that sentence now and writing a tiny migration checklist at the top (what to change in config, how to test). anyone object to merging after one more LGTM?

mike_eng: LGTM from eng side.

lisa_pm: LGTM from PM — please merge after CI link-check passes.

devbot: CI: docs-lint ✅, link-check ❌ (1 broken link) — see lisa_pm inline comment

anna_docs: fixed the link, rebased, pushed. final smoke pass locally. merging in ~5m.

mike_eng: thanks all — nice crisp examples, should reduce support noise.

anna_docs: merged. will follow up with a short changelog bullet for the release notes. :tada:
